provenance: Hunt & Reffert 2024, DOI 10.1051/0004-6361/202348662; Gaia DR3 lineage qualified by Hunt 2023 and ESA DR3 definitions; nominal centre model.

hunt_2023.finding: Gaia DR3 astrometry; density-mode centres and core-member mean astrometry.

hunt_2024.finding: Updated cluster catalogue based on Paper II.

gaia_reference.finding: TCB astrometry in BCRS with solar-system-barycentric origin and ICRS-aligned axes.

gaia_data_model.finding: Julian-year TCB reference epoch; barycentric ICRS directions and mu_alpha_star.

gaia_motion.finding: Rectilinear barycentric astrometric model, perspective effects and light-arrival time convention.

heasarc.finding: J2000 equinox alone; source-coded mean motions and errors; original source references needed.

D14.finding: Cluster pmRAc is mu_alpha*cos(delta), ICRS; table2 positions labelled at J2000.0; no epoch time scale.

qualification_basis: source-derived inheritance, not an explicit declaration in the cluster ReadMe

limits.coverage: Explicit finite nominal model domain required at admission; not certified physical validity.
limits.uncertainty: Centre measurement/model/numerical bounds and cluster-mean covariance remain not evaluated.
limits.source: Four Dias-only rows have no qualified physical epoch; missing RV refuses the full model.
limits.adoption: Explicit API only; source lookup and existing charts are unchanged.

distance_estimator: dist50, published 50th percentile of maximum-likelihood cluster distance; not inverse mean parallax or a Gaussian error model
